noah: quick flag: customer FinnCo LoRA merge into raven-7b-int4 shows a spike in hallucinations on invoice fields in the quick-eval.

tara: numbers?

noah: quick summary:
```
./run_eval --model raven-7b-int4+finnco-lora --dataset invoices-qa --metric exact_match
EM: 0.58 (baseline raven-7b-int4 0.91)
```

eli: that's huge. does the LoRA change any special tokens or BOS handling?

noah: they added <INVOICE> token during finetune, but id appended at end of vocab. vocab size still matches.

ci-bot: artifact created: finco-lora-merge-3119990000

tara: can you repro without merging (LoRA merge at runtime)?

noah: LoRA only inference EM 0.89. merged fp32 EM 0.88. merged+int4 EM 0.58. so it's merge+int4 interaction.

eli: collect logits for failing example and KV cache dumps. tiny shifts will show where it flips.

noah: pasted logits snippet:
```
input: "Amount due:"
fp32-merged top: {"$": 10.2, "due": 8.5, "Jan": 2.0}
int4-merged top: {"Jan": 11.1, "$": 6.2, "31": 1.8}
```

tara: suggests per-head scale/clamp during quantization flips attention. i'll audit the packer for recent clamp changes.

eli: i'll repro on triton vs reference kernels, assign to infra.

noah: uploaded artifacts: https://redwood.internal/runs/3119990000/artifacts (kv diffs + failing cases)

ci-bot: nightly-eval scheduled 2026-03-22T03:30Z
